ja: 『機動戦士ガンダムユニコーン episode4-重力の井戸の底で-』劇場公開（11月12日）の公開を記念して、
ユニコーンガンダムの限定アイテムが‘ホビーオンラインショップ’に登場！
劇中に登場のＭ.Ｓ.を揃えて、ユニコーンの世界観を堪能しよう！
●劇中に登場のジムIIを再現する専用マーキング付属
●劇中イメージのデザートカラーの成形色
●頭部カメラ及びビームサーベルの刃はクリアで再現
●自由度の高い可動域で、射撃ポーズも動きのあるポーズで再現可能
１／１４４スケール組み立て式プラモデル
※組み立てに接着剤は使用しません

en: To commemorate the release of "Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn episode 4 -At the Bottom of the Gravity Well-" in theaters (1112),
Unicorn Gundam limited items are now available at the ‘Hobby Online Shop’!
Get the MS that appears in the movie and enjoy the world of unicorns!
-Special marking included to reproduce Jim II that appears in the play
- Molded color of desert color as imaged in the play
-The head camera and beam saber blade are clearly reproduced.
-With a high degree of freedom of movement, shooting poses can be reproduced in dynamic poses.
Target age: 8 years old and above
*No adhesive is used in the assembly
・This product is a limited edition item.
*We may sell items at events sponsored by our company or other projects.
*Cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・Product images are prototypes. Specifications may change slightly.
- Product specifications are scheduled as of 201111. Please note that there may be changes.
